rows.note: Product named by title ('SWOT Level 2 River Single-Pass Vector Data Product') and family name ('SWOT_HR_L2_RiverSP'), not by ShortName. The RiverSP version used is not documented; mapped to the current Version D combined collection (reach + node). Version C (SWOT_L2_HR_RiverSP_2.0) and the separate _reach_/_node_ collections also exist in CMR.
